Flagged as a likely docs copy-paste error rather than silently corrected.

cross_component_finding: RETENTION IS SCOPED THREE WAYS, AND THIS PAGE IS THE FIRST TO SHOW ALL THREE TOGETHER. Round 19's backup-service.json only established repository/plan-level retention (backup:retention-period configurableVia backup:plan). This page adds: (1) setting retention when CREATING a repository, (2) EDITING it later at repository level, and (3) overriding it for an INDIVIDUAL backup within the repository - each with its own URI (retentionSettings vs retentionSettings/<backup-name>) and its own `retroactive` flag controlling whether a repository-level change reaches backups that already exist. None of this three-way scoping is described on backup-service.md, which only ever says the period is 'specified in the plan.' The REST reference here is materially more detailed than the conceptual overview page, consistent with this round's ongoing observation (also made in round 19's own cross_component_finding about backup-service.md itself) that the reference-versus-conceptual split does not track directory placement, and here it does not track the batch/round split either: the REST layer keeps turning out to be the more complete source of truth for exactly how a Backup-Service mechanism actually works.
